items.title: Bracelet capacity expansion
items.text: The Dobbaspet steel bracelet plant, already at 75-80% utilisation, is expanding from ~75,000 to ~110,000-120,000 units over the next 12 months. Management targets ~25% CAGR for bracelets, with a ₹80-100 crore revenue potential over 3-5 years versus ~₹40 crore in FY26.

items.title: Eigen backward integration
items.text: In-house electroplating capacity, expected operational by end of Q1 FY27, brings a currently outsourced process inside for quality and volume ramp-up. This supports Eigen's 20-25% CAGR target, with the division already contributing ~38% of company revenue and growing >35% in FY26.

items.title: Favre-Leuba global rollout
items.text: The brand is present in over 20 countries with more than 80 points of sale, with sales "much better than expected" and most stores short of stock. Sales are expected to more than double in FY27, with losses set to disappear from FY28 onwards.

items.title: Ethos boutique doubling
items.text: Ethos crossed 100 boutiques in FY26 and targets doubling its network in the next 3 years, with a new format launching this year at ₹25,000-₹2 lakh price points. The 10x revenue in 10 years goal (25.9-26% CAGR) is reaffirmed, with the company ahead of that vision.

items.title: Ornapac export push
items.text: The Panchkula packaging unit, at 60-70% utilisation in FY26, is targeting exports to global luxury brands after domestic supplies to international brands commenced with encouraging response. The division is expected to turn profitable in H2 FY27, with a 25% CAGR target and ₹80-100 crore long-term opportunity.

items.title: Watch components recovery
items.text: Excluding Ethos, watch component revenue grew ~20% YoY to ~₹240 crore in FY26, with H1 FY27 expected stable and growth more visible in H2 FY27. Diversification beyond Switzerland into Japan, USA, UK, Italy and the Middle East, plus premiumisation, supports an 8-10% projected improvement.

items.title: Pylania precious stone dials
items.text: Infrastructure development and product design for high-end precious stone watch dials targeting premium Swiss brands is underway. This moves KDDL up the value chain into artisanal, higher-margin products, complementing the new Artisan Watch Products subsidiary that commenced commercial operations in late 2025.
